findings.label: Connection-only key collapses co-located models
findings.detail: The gate keys conn:<id> with the connection's max_concurrent, so a connection hosting both a 27B and a 9B (4070 Ti b20e0770; 5090 e9bd13fb per plan.md) collapses the two models onto one shared ceiling instead of the per-model 1/4 and 2/2 splits the plan designed. This deviates from plan.md (which specified conn:<id>:<model>) but satisfies this review's gate criterion #1, which explicitly accepts conn:<connectionId> keying. It strictly improves on the pre-change state (no priority-path gate at all) and matches the existing connection-scoped isAccountSemaphoreFull pattern. Does not block. Revisit with conn:<id>:<model> if the per-model split must be enforced.

findings.label: Missing per-model-independence test
findings.detail: Plan items 5 and 6(b) required a test proving model A (cap 1) and model B (cap 4) on one shared connection enforce independently and simultaneously. It is absent because connection-only keying cannot express it. Direct symptom of the design deviation, not a coverage oversight. Add it only if the design moves to conn:<id>:<model>.

findings.label: Verification doc understates the deviation
findings.detail: verification.md records the connection-only key and the reconciliation but does not note that co-located models now share one ceiling, silently dropping the plan's 4070 Ti 27B/9B (1/4) and 5090 27B/9B (2/2) per-model splits. Document the trade-off so a later reader does not assume the per-model split holds.

confirmations.globalCapAcrossCombos: PASS — process-global semaphore keyed conn:<connectionId>, acquired at the handleSingleModelWithTimeout chokepoint in executeTargetAttempt; two different combos on the same connection share one ceiling (dispatch test: cap=2, third waits, never three). Criterion #1 explicitly accepts conn:<connectionId> keying.
confirmations.releaseTimingForStreams: PASS — streaming success hands slot ownership to a ReadableStream wrapper; release fires only on close/cancel/error after the body is fully drained; slotHandedToStream prevents the finally from freeing early. Spot-check re-ran dispatch suite: 5 pass.
confirmations.failOpenPreserved: PASS — no connectionId / cap===null / cap<=0 -> null; saturated queue / timeout -> warn + null; cap lookup wrapped in .catch(() => null). Matches acquireQuotaShareConcurrencySlot.
confirmations.noDoubleAcquire: PASS — round-robin never reaches the chokepoint (keeps combo:<name>:<step>); quota-share keeps qsconn:<id> and is skipped here; priority/weighted/fill-first/dispatchSequence/fallback share conn:<id>. Reconciliation and the qsconn-vs-conn caveat documented in the helper header.
confirmations.noOtherLaneImpact: PASS for routing/sequence/window — whitespace-insensitive diff of executeTargetAttempt.ts shows only gate plumbing added; no contextWindow/maxTokens/dispatchSequence/weight/cap/timeout literal changed; the dispatchSequence+combo schema changes belong to the separate prior commit 94ca490d8. Note: co-located models now share a connection ceiling (see finding 1), a consequence of the gate's keying, not a routing/sequence/window edit.
confirmations.testsPresentAndMeaningful: PASS — gate helper (9 tests) and dispatch integration (5 tests) exist with meaningful assertions covering five required cases; coder's recorded run passed (gate 9/0, dispatch 5/0, closest suites 23/0, typecheck clean, eslint 0 errors). Verification evidence present and internally consistent.
